But if you go back into the setup screens and change it again then the software will retain that change. &nbsp; From: Mastercam Support &lt;cases@mastercam.com&gt; Sent: Sunday, November 15, 2026 9:34 PM To: Son Nguyen &lt;son@abmachine-inc.com&gt; Subject: Case Number 00142753 - Mill Turn Spindle Speed Settings [  ] &nbsp; &nbsp; [Inline image name: ~WRD3366.jpg] &nbsp; Son, &nbsp; The maximum spindle speed settings can be adjusted and saved directly within Mastercam's Mill Turn Machine Configuration. &nbsp; To change these settings, open Machine Group Setup, select Machine Configuration, and enter your desired maximum RPM for the left and right spindles. Once configured, you can save these settings as an .mtConfig file for future use. &nbsp; These settings are retained within your existing Mastercam part file. When starting a new part, simply use the Load option under Machine Configuration to import your saved .mtConfig file. &nbsp; I've attached an example configuration with both spindle limits set to 100 RPM, along with screenshots illustrating the process. &amp;nbsp;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
The maximum spindle speed settings can be adjusted and saved directly within Mastercam's Mill Turn Machine Configuration.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
&amp;nbsp;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
To change these settings, open Machine Group Setup, select Machine Configuration, and enter your desired maximum RPM for the left and right spindles. Once configured, you can save these settings as an .mtConfig file for future use.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
&amp;nbsp;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
These settings are retained within your existing Mastercam part file. When starting a new part, simply use the Load option under Machine Configuration to import your saved .mtConfig file.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
&amp;nbsp;&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
I've attached an example configuration with both spindle limits set to 100 RPM, along with screenshots illustrating the process. I've also verified that both G50 commands correctly reflect these settings when posting.&lt;br clear=&quot;none&quot;&gt;
